newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Van Der Horst in S$204 mln toll project.
newsitem.headline: Van Der Horst in S$204 mln toll project.

text.p: Engineering firm Van Der Horst confirmed on Monday it has entered a S$204 million joint venture project to develop and operate a 24.5 km toll road in Indonesia.

Van Der Horst (VDHL) said in a statement that on September 26, it and its associate company PT Super Indah Makmur and two Indonesian firms, PT Infratek Indonusa and PT Jasa Marga, signed an agreement for the Build-Operate-Transfer toll road project in West Java.

It said a joint venture company PT D-P Marga Sakti would be incorporated in Indonesia to undertake the project. VDHL will hold a 36 percent stake in the joint venture, making it the majority shareholder.
PT Super Indah Makmur, PT Infratek Indonusa and PT Jasa Marga will each hold four percent, 30 percent and 30 percent stakes in the joint venture respectively.

VDHL said its investment costs would be financed by internal resources and debt financing and would not have any material impact on the group's earnings for the year ended September 30 1996. -- Singapore newsroom (65 8703080)
